spec2def(mssign32.dll mssign32.spec)

# mssign32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mssign32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(mssign32_shims OBJECT mssign32_main.c)
target_link_libraries(mssign32_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(mssign32_shims)
add_cargo_module(mssign32 mssign32-cargo mssign32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mssign32_shims psdk)
